description: Verify that Error message echoes Request Message ID (Service ID + Method ID)
approach:
[Objective]
Error message echoes Request Message ID (Service ID + Method ID).

[Scenario — chronological]
DUT offers service; tester sends a Method Request (or specific stimulus); the resulting wire response is verified against the spec property.

[Pass condition]
Response / behaviour matches the asserted property.

[Fail condition]
Per-phase Fail_phase<n>_* per the verdict list.

verdicts.Fail_phase2_id_mismatch: Error message did not echo Request Message ID
verdicts.Fail_phase2_no_error: No Error message within listen window
